name: Subway Platform
desc: An endless subway platform seen from standing height with the vanishing point hard off-centre — grimed tile bands and lit advert boxes creep past on the left, rails and sleepers converge on a black tunnel arch, and every half-minute a train boils out of it, headlight first, and sweeps the frame.

energy.doc: lamp output, advert glow, headlight bloom and camera drift

scale.doc: platform width / ceiling height / track gauge vs frame (2.2 = a cavernous vault; Z pitch stays fixed so this is never a no-op)

density.doc: how many bays of platform recede to the tunnel mouth

speed.doc: rate the camera creeps down the platform

hue.doc: lamp hue; tile takes its complement

x.doc: vanishing point across frame — this is the off-centre that makes it a platform and not a corridor

trains.doc: how often a train runs (0 = the station is abandoned, 1 = one every ~34s)

style.doc: aesthetic: fluorescent institutional tile / amber sodium grime / hard monochrome chiaroscuro / cyan schematic linework / hatched paper plate

seed.doc: advert placement, dead lamps, tile discolouration
